clues.it: Elena era a nord di Fabio e in Serra.
clues.en: Elena was north of Fabio and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Nino era nella 5ª colonna, accanto a un droide e in Serra.
clues.en: Nino was in the 5th column, beside a droid and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 4ª colonna, nella 3ª riga e a ovest di Nino.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 4th column, in the 3rd row and west of Nino.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 4ª riga e a ovest di Nino.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 4th row and west of Nino.

clues.it: Fabio era esattamente una riga a nord di Carla e da solo sul Ponte di Comando.
clues.en: Fabio was exactly one row north of Carla and alone on the Command Deck.

clues.it: Carla era nella 8ª colonna e a ovest di Irene.
clues.en: Carla was in the 8th column and west of Irene.

clues.it: Luca era nella 6ª colonna e nella 7ª riga, ma non era accanto a un fascio di cavi.
clues.en: Luca was in the 6th column and in the 7th row, but was not beside a cable bundle.

clues.it: Irene era a nord di Sergio e in Laboratorio.
clues.en: Irene was north of Sergio and in the Lab.

clues.it: Paolo era l'unica persona su una grata e a ovest di Fabio.
clues.en: Paolo was the only person on a floor grate and west of Fabio.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

general_clues.it: 2 accanto a un fascio di cavi.

steps.it: Solo Elena può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 3ª è sua.
steps.en: Elena is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 3rd is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Nino lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Nino's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 4th.

steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 6th.

steps.en: Paolo is the only one who can be in the 9th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 7th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Sergio più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 10ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Sergio's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 10th, column 2nd.
